items.question: Is tipping mandatory for restaurant and café customers in the UAE?
items.gold: No, tipping is common in the UAE but not mandatory.
items.fact: UAE tipping is common but not mandatory

items.question: What is Khuzi in traditional Emirati food?
items.gold: Stuffed whole roast lamb or goat on a bed of spiced rice.
items.fact: Khuzi is stuffed whole roast lamb or goat
